svg.title: Flare SM70 long-context decode
svg.desc: Decode-only at 28.7k tokens of context, one Tesla V100 PCIe 32 GB, package f21b9abb on server binary 48b69ed4, 2026-10-24: one agent, cold requests, median 72.9 tok/s (64.9 to 77.0); four agents in the first batch, per agent 27.6, 32.6, 53.6, 63.4 tok/s (median 43.1); some decode while others are still in prefill. Previous package fd7c24dc: 72.4 and 41.9. Source: BENCHMARKS-SM70.md.
